notes: Original report (2026-05-28): title says 24GB, body says 16GB VRAM, measured peak 15.1 GB, FitLLM estimate 26.7 (wont fit). Reconstruction on the engine revision deployed that day reproduces used=26.71 exactly for BOTH 16GB and 24GB Macs at 4bit/32K, while a 128GB Mac produced 25.71 with a fits verdict — so the reported estimate can only have come from a 16-24GB Mac, using the built-in catalog entry (present since 2026-05-25; the site was Apple-only until GPU mode shipped 2026-06-04). A third-party follow-up (2026-07-10) attributed this measurement to an M5 Max 128GB via oMLX; that attribution is contradicted by the 26.7 figure itself and was mistakenly written into this entry on 2026-07-10 — reverted 2026-07-11. measurementKind=unknown: the 15.1 readings methodology is unverified and the original reporter has not confirmed. If the device was a 24GB Mac the model demonstrably runs there, making this a real small-Mac over-conservatism case (Apple reserve/overhead stack), tracked in issue #1 (reopened 2026-07-11).

Measured on M5 Max 128GB via the oMLX fork's /engine/loaded endpoint (actual resident bytes) — the same metric issue #2 used. Source figure 30.4 GiB is taken from the issue #2 table; not re-measured this session because the model was not resident at measurement time. oMLX reports estimated_size 31.72 GiB for the full 8-bit MoE weights, so 30.4 resident reflects dFlash SSD expert offload (active experts only). ctx=32768 and kvBits=16 are the oMLX defaults (max_context_window global default; unquantized fp16 KV) — the Coder was not loaded this session so its per-model ctx/KV settings were not directly re-read, but the 30.4 figure is weight-residency-dominated and effectively ctx-independent. Issue #2 is closed (parseHfConfig bit-width fix landed).

Measured live this session from oMLX /admin/api/models -> Qwen3.6-27B-4bit.actual_size = 16,457,805,464 bytes = 15.33 GiB (oMLX's own formatted label). This is oMLX's per-model resident-bytes field — identical to what the fork's /engine/loaded endpoint reports (commit 373d09b: memory_bytes = actual_size). config_model_type=qwen3_5 (Gated-DeltaNet / linear-attention hybrid), so the recurrent state is ctx-independent and resident memory does not scale with context length — the linear-attention calibration datapoint issue #2 asked for. ctx=32768 = oMLX global default max_context_window (per-model setting null -> inherits default, omlx/server.py:244 + model_settings.py:38). kvBits=16 from the loaded engine's settings (turboquant_kv_enabled=false -> unquantized fp16 KV). Idle measurement (no active generation); excludes generation-time activation growth, so treat as floor not peak-during-gen. Reported in GiB to match issue #2's convention (decimal-GB equivalent: 16.46). NOTE: this is the 4-bit variant — the only Qwen3.6-27B resident at measurement time; the oQ8-mtp (8-bit) variant was registered but NOT loaded, so no number is reported for it. The source URL is the fork PR and resolves once opened; repoint to the upstream PR URL if preferred.
